request: code-review flags SEC-007 XSS on every innerHTML assignment even when output is escaped via esc()
detail: app.js uses esc() helper on all interpolated values inserted via innerHTML (lines 125,133,138,176,205,225,234). SEC-007 heuristic flags all of them as critical; in reality they are safe because untrusted data is escaped.
suggested_fix: Detect esc()-wrapped interpolations or a project-level escape helper; suppress SEC-007 (or downgrade to warning) when innerHTML source is built only from escaped variables. Document the esc() exception in the skill.

request: EDGE-004 'division by zero' misfires inside CSS url()/data: SVG backgrounds
detail: styles.css lines 40/127 contain background:url('data:image/svg+xml,...width='12' height='7'...') — the '/' inside the SVG path/attributes is parsed as division and flagged EDGE-004. False positive; CSS url() contexts contain no arithmetic.
suggested_fix: Do not run EDGE (arithmetic) checks inside CSS url()/data: URI contexts; exclude url(...) token spans from EDGE-004. Lower STYLE-004 noise on long data: URIs.
